column1: Table A. Point coordinates of plots.  This table contains the geographical information  of each point coordinate that was created within the reserve (SWEREF99, WGS84 in normal and decimal form, altitude). Each point coordinate was given a random plotnumber which defined the order of the inventory. A plot is the circular area with a radius of 7 m that lies around a point coordinate. Whether a plot was inventoried, excluded or not treated is shown in the column Status. Because of time restrictions only the first plots could be inventoried. Plots were excluded when they fell into the lake or when the center was < 7 m away from the reserve border.
